promotions.name: North Kalimantan Legislative Webcasts
promotions.institution: Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah Provinsi Kalimantan Utara
promotions.notes: The provincial legislature profile explicitly designates @dprdprov.kaltara. A KPID selection hearing and a separate plenary presentation of the 2024 government accountability report were visually checked beyond opening graphics, at 30 and 20 minutes respectively. The hearing room banner, legislators, plenary room and institutional branding match the provincial DPRD. These historical recordings do not establish current live coverage.

promotions.name: Arauca Assembly Webcasts
promotions.notes: The departmental assembly homepage explicitly designates channel UCqTycM15CbUe1zv5Xo0n1zw. Ordinary sittings labelled 22 and 21 October 2026 were visually reviewed at ten minutes with speakers, chamber flags and institutional room setting. Current live and every committee room remain separate checks.

promotions.name: Caquetá Assembly Webcasts
promotions.notes: The departmental assembly homepage explicitly designates channel UCnv4PhFlCBm4pXvHOzkaCfg. An environmental public hearing labelled 22 October 2026 and a distinct victims-policy sitting labelled 21 October were visually checked at ten and thirty minutes. Deputies, chamber nameplates, assembly branding and substantive presentations are visible. The latter topic also matches the homepage order-of-day entry for 21 October. One WebKit inspection was interrupted by a detached provider frame; the same sample passed a bounded retry. Current live and complete committee coverage remain unverified.

promotions.name: Risaralda Assembly Webcasts
promotions.notes: The assembly homepage explicitly labels @asambleadepartamental-comu59/streams as its live-session destination. Ordinary sittings labelled 22 and 21 October 2026 were checked at forty minutes, beyond introductory tourism material, and show substantive 2027 legal and education budget presentations with regional institutional branding. Finance and planning committee recordings also appear in the provider index but were not individually playback-certified. Current live and full room coverage remain unresolved.
